analysis.title: Textron Inc. (TXT): Mixed fundamentals keep us Neutral
key_insights: GS keeps TXT at Neutral with a 12-month price target of $94 (prior $93), 9.7% upside from $85.70. The target is based on 9.0X 2027E EV/EBITDA, unchanged.
3Q26 adjusted EPS was $1.76 versus FactSet consensus of $1.43 and GS estimate of $1.51. Total revenue of $3,751mn was about 1% below FactSet consensus and manufacturing segment EBIT was 2% above.
Total revenue grew 4% yoy and the consolidated operating margin fell 40 bps yoy to 9.5%.

Aviation revenue rose 14% yoy on higher aircraft and aftermarket revenue. EBIT margin fell 140 bps yoy to 10.7% on manufacturing inefficiencies and mix. Demand is solid but delivery growth is constrained.
Aviation backlog was flat sequentially (up 4% yoy) at $8.0bn. Quarterly book-to-bill was 0.98X and TTM book-to-bill is 1.05X.

Bell revenue fell 9% yoy on lower military revenue and EBIT margin fell 90 bps yoy on lower volume and unfavorable mix. Bell backlog was $7.6bn, up 1% sequentially, with book-to-bill of 1.07X (0.88X TTM).
GS expects Bell to have high long-term growth from MV75, but medium-term EBIT is limited by mix and the LRIP structure.
Systems revenue rose 17% yoy on new products in high-priority areas, though EBIT margin fell 110 bps yoy. Backlog was $3.5bn, up 5% sequentially, with book-to-bill of 1.42X (1.22X TTM).
Industrial revenue rose 1% yoy and EBIT margin rose 90 bps yoy. Industrial missed GS revenue and margin estimates.
TXT raised 2026 guidance: adjusted EPS $6.55-6.65 (prior $6.40-6.60, consensus $6.42) and manufacturing cash flow $800-900mn (prior $700-800mn).
Adjusted free cash flow was $418mn versus $281mn a year ago, and TXT repurchased $239mn of shares in the quarter.
GS raised 2026-2028E adjusted EPS to $6.63/$7.22/$8.37 from $6.47/$7.12/$8.19. 2029E and 2030E are $9.47 and $10.57 versus $9.18 and $10.23 prior, on changes to segment revenue and margins.
GS says the valuation bar is not demanding, but the fundamental picture across segments is mixed. The stock is at 12.9X 2026E P/E and 8.1X 2026E EV/EBITDA.
TXT is down 1.6% over 3 months and 10.7% over 6 months, and up 7.9% over 12 months. Relative to the S&P 500 it is down 5.2%, 16.6% and 4.6% over those windows.
Goldman Sachs is disclosed as acting as financial advisor in connection with an announced strategic matter involving Textron.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral reiterated after 3Q26. Aviation and Systems beat on revenue and margins versus consensus, while Bell and Industrial missed. The price target moves to $94 from $93 on higher estimates.

3Q26 manufacturing segment operating profit $350mn reported versus GS estimate $337mn and $339mn in 3Q25. Manufacturing segment operating margin was 9.4%, down 10 bps yoy.
3Q26 segment operating profit: Aviation $179mn (flat yoy), Bell $76mn (-17.4% yoy), Systems $57mn (+9.6% yoy), Industrial $38mn (+22.6% yoy).

Reported adjusted FCF was $418mn versus $281mn in 3Q25. Share repurchases were $239mn in the quarter.
2026 guidance (October update): adjusted EPS $6.55-6.65 (prior $6.40-6.60, consensus $6.42), manufacturing cash flow $800-900mn (prior $700-800mn), capex ~$550mn (prior ~$650mn).
GS estimates: 2026E EPS $6.63 (prior $6.47), 2027E $7.22 (prior $7.12), 2028E $8.37 (prior $8.19). Quarterly GS EPS estimates are $1.81 for 12/26E, $1.48 for 3/27E and $1.78 for 6/27E.
